_note: Plan rows adjudicated out of scope or otherwise unauthorable, with the ruling that settled each. `plan.mjs next` and `status` drop them, so a row decided once is never rediscovered by the next agent. This is the same shape as wikidata-exceptions.json: a judgement a person has made, recorded so the machine stops asking. Remove a row here to put it back in the queue.
_rules: slug -> reason. The reason is shown by `plan.mjs skips`, so write it for whoever reopens the question.

skips.5-56x30mm-minsas: Blocked: `caseType` is mandatory and no free source publishes it. Reopen when a source appears; it unblocks amogh-carbine and the JVPC.
skips.amogh-carbine: Blocked, not out of scope: chambered only in 5.56x30mm MINSAS, whose `caseType` is mandatory and unpublished by any free source. Reopen with the cartridge.
skips.armalite-ar-100: A design study derived from the AR-16 with no evidence of series production; the single-paragraph article cannot meet the publication floor. Series production is the test (item 16). Requeue if a source showing production appears.
skips.buffalo-rifle: A class article, not a model.
skips.coach-gun: A class article, not a model.
skips.cz-2000: A prototype rifle family that never entered production (item 16).
skips.elephant-gun: A class article, not a model. No single arm to author.
skips.emer-k1: A 15-16 unit trial batch, never adopted; later reverse-engineered into the unrelated MA-1 Mk III. Never series-produced (item 16).
skips.gatling-gun: Crew-served — outside the one-or-two-person boundary (SPEC scope ruling, item 16).
skips.glock: The article already backs `glock-17`. It is the pistol brand, not a model.
skips.gyrojet: Fires self-propelled rockets, not cartridges — the rocket-launcher exclusion (item 16).
skips.heckler-koch-g11: Blocked as a cartridge row: the 4.73x33mm is caseless, so it has no head or rim geometry and mandatory caseType has no truthful value, and its case is its propellant, which the no-propellant red line forbids describing. The G11 rifle itself is not blocked by this ruling.
skips.joint-venture-protective-carbine: Blocked, not out of scope: its 5.56x30mm MINSAS cartridge cannot be authored because `caseType` is mandatory and no free source publishes it. Reopen when a source appears.
skips.lemat-revolver: A percussion (cap-and-ball) revolver: loaded with loose powder and ball, not a cartridge, so it has no chambering to author — the muzzleloader exclusion (item 16). Requeue only if the later pinfire or centrefire LeMat production is sourceable as its own model.
skips.m134-minigun: Externally powered six-barrel rotary gun, mounted on aircraft and vehicles and driven by an electric motor. Fails the carry test — the same ruling as the M61 Vulcan (item 16).
skips.papop: A combined rifle/grenade-launcher demonstrator; never series-produced (item 16).
skips.punt-gun: Crew-served, boat-mounted — outside the scope boundary (item 16).
skips.st-kinetics-cpw: A prototype personal defence weapon; never series-produced (item 16).
skips.winchester-rifle: The article is the whole series, already covered by the authored models.
skips.xm214-microgun: Externally powered rotary gun that never reached series production — the M134 ruling (item 16).
skips.xm29-oicw: A cancelled developmental weapon; never series-produced (item 16).
